faqs.a:
The city council may appoint a special municipal judge at the request of the presiding
               judge in the event of a conflict of interest for the purpose of presiding over a municipal
               court proceeding out of which the conflict of interest arose. The special judge shall
               be an attorney licensed to practice in this state, however, such person need not be
               a resident of the city. The special judge shall be compensated pursuant to an agreement
               which shall identify the case to be handled.
(Code 1981, § 18-44; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
